competitorName.title: Competitor / Brand Name
competitorName.description: The competitor, product, or service to spy on (e.g. 'Slack', 'Jira', 'Notion', 'Salesforce', 'Zoom').
competitorName.sectionDescription: Specify the target brand and volume of signals to analyze.

maxPosts.title: Sample Size Limit
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of community posts and customer signals to retrieve (25 - 1000).

sources.title: Target Channels
sources.description: Select public discussion platforms to extract customer sentiment signals from.
sources.sectionDescription: Select public platforms and optional search modifiers.

customKeywords.title: Custom Search Keywords
customKeywords.description: Optional: Comma-separated query terms to hunt for alongside the brand name (e.g. 'price hike, slow, crashed, cancel, alternative').

focusCategory.title: Pain Point Focus Area
focusCategory.description: Prioritize a specific category of customer complaints, or analyze all areas.

minSentiment.title: Max Sentiment Score (Filter)
minSentiment.description: Maximum sentiment polarity allowed (-1.0 to 0.0). Below -0.05 filters out neutral chatter; below -0.25 targets high frustration.

apiKey.title: AI Copilot API Key (Gemini / OpenAI / Claude / OpenRouter)
apiKey.description: Optional: Paste an API key (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter) to generate executive battlecards and ad hooks. Leave empty for 100% free ML analysis.
apiKey.sectionDescription: Add an optional LLM key to automatically craft competitive battlecards, marketing pitches, and feature roadmaps.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Settings
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended to avoid rate limits and IP blocking during high-volume scans.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Configure Apify Proxy or custom proxies.
